Uses of Record Class
io.mavlink4j.transport.LinkId

Packages that use LinkId
Package
Description
io.mavlink4j.codec
L2 — bytes to Frame and back, plus MAVLink 2 signing.
io.mavlink4j.session
L3 — the MavlinkSession composition root: reader threads, peer directory, dispatcher, correlator, TX scheduler.
io.mavlink4j.testkit
Test doubles for code that talks MAVLink through mavlink4j, with no SITL, socket or hardware needed: a scripted FakeVehicle, in-memory links (RecordingLink, LoopbackLinkPair) and deterministic time (ManualInstantSource, DirectTxScheduler).
io.mavlink4j.transport
L1 — bytes in, bytes out over a MavlinkLink (UDP listen/target, TCP client, serial).

    void
    FrameSink.broadcast(Object message, LinkId link)
    Sends message out link unconditionally, using that link's own MavlinkLink.defaultTarget() — matches the protocol's own broadcast dispatch path (spec: target_system == 0 is an unconditional forward, no learned-route check).
    void
    FrameWriter.broadcast(Object message, LinkId link)
    Sends message (a dialect message class) out link unconditionally, using that link's own MavlinkLink.defaultTarget() — matches the protocol's own broadcast dispatch path (spec: target_system == 0 is an unconditional forward, no learned-route check).
    void
    FrameWriter.removeLink(LinkId id)
    Unregisters a link.
    void
    FrameWriter.sendTo(Object message, LinkId link, LinkPeer address, PeerId target)
    Sends message out link to one explicit address, bypassing MavlinkLink.defaultTarget() entirely, signed for target when SigningKeyResolver.keyFor(int) resolves a key for it (unsigned otherwise).

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    MavlinkSession.onLinkFailure(BiConsumer<LinkId,IOException> listener)
    Registers the listener a reader thread invokes when MavlinkLink.poll(java.time.Duration) throws — a genuine I/O failure, not a timeout or an intentional close (see that method's own contract), and not this session winding down (see below) — instead of runLoop's previous behavior of logging a WARNING and silently returning.
